title: Shared hex namespace for r-/s-; locate dirs by hex
rationale: A bare hex like a1b2 must resolve to exactly one node, and a manual shell mv must never lose a file. New ids avoid every hex in graph.jsonl (nodes+edges) and every <hex>-* dir under human/ and agent/sprouts/. openWorkspace() sets node.slug from a renamed dir (mv event by roots:dir-rename) only when exactly one dir matches and its suffix is a valid, unused slug. events.jsonl has no ids: readEvents drops exact-duplicate lines; events are {type,by,at,node?,refs?} and log filters on node or refs.

title: scan uses scannedHash, not hash
rationale: verify's hash ledger must trust only plant/session.end hashes; otherwise scan would launder out-of-session (possibly agent) edits

name: verify-hash-ledger
description: verify's hash ledger trusts only plant/session.end hashes by human:*; a mismatch passes only if git says the file is clean AND its last commit is not an agent commit (isAgentCommit: [bot], agent names, noreply@anthropic.com, Co-Authored-By). No git => warning. Tests: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null + git -c user.name/-c user.email.

content: Seeds/mulch integration is read-only and zero-dep: read <root>/.seeds/issues.jsonl and <root>/.mulch/expertise/*.jsonl directly (dedup last-wins, tolerate unknown fields). Seeds link precedence: explicit intent field (string|string[], or extensions.intent) is authoritative; else exact r-xxxx token in title/description/labels (idea-refs.ts citedIdeaIds). Mulch: any string field anywhere in a record citing the token.
